visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses and a black jacket stands beside a seated elderly woman in a purple vest. They are in a cluttered indoor room with shelves and curtains. A table before them is scattered with cash bills. (2) The elderly woman holds a pink sticky hand toy, slapping it onto the cash bills while smiling broadly. The young man stands behind her, cheering and clapping. (3) A middle-aged woman in a purple shirt enters the frame, taking a turn with the sticky hand toy. She misses a bill and laughs while the others in the room react with joy. (4) Another woman wearing sunglasses takes a quick turn, successfully picking up a bill with the toy. (5) A middle-aged man in a grey vest and glasses leans over the table to try the game, successfully lifting a bill as the crowd cheers. (6) The elderly woman is seen placing more bills and a red envelope onto the table, preparing for the next round. (7) A man in a black sweatshirt tries his hand at the game, grabbing a bill while the grandson watches closely. (8) The sticky hand toy accidentally attaches to the grandson's back; the elderly woman points and laughs hysterically while the grandson smiles and claps. (9) A woman with glasses and a black 'Heaven' hoodie attempts the game, successfully grabbing a 500 dollar bill. (10) A younger boy in a navy New Balance hoodie and then another boy in a black Moncler t-shirt take turns, both successfully grabbing cash. (11) The young man in the black jacket stands next to the elderly woman, smiling and wishing her well. He touches her shoulder affectionately as the video ends.
